description: The art of the longsword and sword & buckler, preceding the later development of fencing.  Designed for combat both unarmored and in armor, it includes grappling as well as defensive and offensive sword techniques.  This style is a combination of the Italian and German traditions.
initiate: You take on a knightly stance.

static_buffs.name: Swordsman's Stance
static_buffs.description:
Through chivalry and vigilance, your defense with a blade has increased.

+1 block attempt, blocked damage reduced by 50% of Strength.

onblock_buffs.name: Mastercut
onblock_buffs.description:
You parry and return the attack with greater vigor!

+10% damage, -10% move cost.
Lasts 1 turn.

onhit_buffs.name: Conserve Momentum
onhit_buffs.description:
You maintain the momentum from your last strike to move more quickly.

-20% move cost.
Lasts 2 turns.

onpause_buffs.name: Half Swording
onpause_buffs.description:
You grip the blade partway down for greater control.

Blocked damage reduced by 50% of Strength, -1 accuracy.
Enables "Grab" and "Lethal Strike" techniques.
Lasts 2 turns.

description: Ninjutsu is a martial art and set of tactics used by ninja in feudal Japan.  It focuses on rapid, precise, silent strikes.  Ninjutsu is almost entirely silent and you have a higher chance to critically hit on your first attack.  It also provides small combat bonuses every time you move.
initiate: You perform a kuji-in mantra with your hands.  Rin, Kai, Jin!
%s performs a series of intricate hand signs.

static_buffs.name: Ninjutsu Stance
static_buffs.description:
Your training allows you to make no noise when attacking and less noise when moving around.

Melee and unarmed attacks generate 0 noise, moving generates 1/2 as much noise.

static_buffs.name: Sneak Attack
static_buffs.description:
To a true shinobi, the first strike and the last strike are one and the same.

+25% critical hit chance.

onattack_buffs.name: Loss of Surprise
onattack_buffs.description:
Your intentions are known!  It will take you a few moments to sneak attack again.

Disables "Sneak Attack" buff and "Assassinate" and "Ninjutsu Takedown" techniques.  Enables "Swift Strike (crit)" technique.
Lasts 3 turns, persists after switching styles.

onmove_buffs.name: Momentum Shift
onmove_buffs.description:
Ninja are trained to be extremely agile and mobile.

+1.0 Dodging skill, accuracy increased by 20% of Dexterity.
Lasts 1 turn.

onkill_buffs.name: Escape Plan
onkill_buffs.description:
Your target has perished.  It is time to leave and plan your next attack.

+2 dodge attempts, +10 movement speed.
Lasts 3 turns, persists after switching styles.

description: Pencak Silat, of Indonesian origin, is a fighting style that covers the use of short blades and bludgeons.  Fighters stay low and mobile to avoid attacks, then unleash deadly critical hits.
initiate: You give a salute of respect as you prepare for combat.

static_buffs.name: Silat Stance
static_buffs.description:
You try to stay as loose as possible when fighting to have more chances to dodge.

+1 dodge attempt.

ondodge_buffs.name: Silat Appraisal
ondodge_buffs.description:
Each time you dodge an attack, you learn a bit more about your opponent's fighting style.  This allows you to make more precise attacks against them.

Accuracy increased by 15% of Dexterity.
Lasts 2 turns.  Stacks 3 times.

onmove_buffs.name: Silat Ambush
onmove_buffs.description:
You stay low as you move, making it harder for enemies to defend against you.

+5% critical hit chance.
Lasts 1 turn.

description: Sōjutsu, "The Way of the Spear", is the Japanese martial art of fighting with a spear.  Sōjutsu focuses on keeping opponents at a distance in order to maintain the advantage in combat.  Standing still gives you an extra block attempt but moving will briefly increase your damage.
initiate: You prepare to defend against all that approach you.

static_buffs.name: Sōjutsu Stance
static_buffs.description:
Your training grants better defense while using a polearm.

+1 block attempt, +2 blocking effectiveness.

onmove_buffs.name: Superior Positioning
onmove_buffs.description:
You have given up your defenses for a moment to increase the damage of your attacks.

+10% damage, -1 block attempt.
Lasts 1 turn.
